notes: Object insert. q2 and q3 are determinate since 2026-10-31 (no; two), so the record has no worlds; q3 (a count) is fol. q1 (the earlier-known site on the same island) is a find through the island (inv(has_norse_site) then has_norse_site), with L'Anse aux Meadows on Newfoundland as its bridge (firm). q2 ('the only confirmed Norse site in North America outside Greenland') is a closed claim with a nominal; a Norse site on Newfoundland is such a site (firm), so the edit's new site, distinct from L'Anse aux Meadows, makes the claim inconsistent: no. Both relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.find: brannock : inv(has_norse_site) some (has_norse_site some ({?} and EarlierKnownNorseSite and UNESCOWorldHeritageSite))

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): counts the members of a collection (two)

fol.notes: Sites are an enumeration (L'Anse aux Meadows, the site at Brannock Tickle, and other_site for any other); being a confirmed Norse site in North America outside Greenland (norse_site), being known before 2025 (earlier_known) and the island a site is on (island_of) are beliefs. The stored 'L'Anse aux Meadows is the only one' is a closed claim the insert contradicts: a presupposition every world gives up (FINDINGS A1). The count needs a closed world: every confirmed site the model knows of is one of the two named ones (presupposition), and the count rule counts the sites of the domain (firm, definitional). q1 asks for the earlier-known site x on the same island as the new one (given); the closed world and the edit's 'found in 2025' are what make it unique, so the island step of the chain is not in the core.

local.island_of: island_of(s): the island site s is on; the functional value form of located_in to an island.

lam_site.says: L'Anse aux Meadows, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known since the 1960s, is a confirmed Norse site on the northern tip of the island of Newfoundland. (stored)

lam_only.says: L'Anse aux Meadows is the only confirmed Norse site in North America outside Greenland. (stored)

named_only.says: Every confirmed Norse site in North America outside Greenland the model knows of is L'Anse aux Meadows or the site at Brannock Tickle. (closed world)
named_only.z3: ForAll(s, Implies(norse_site(s), Or(s == lam, s == brannock_site)))

count_def.says: The number of confirmed Norse sites in North America outside Greenland is how many sites are confirmed Norse sites.

x_site.says: x is an earlier-known Norse site, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, on the same island as the site found in 2025 at Brannock Tickle.
